fields.description: First word of the 48-byte profile block (rev8-logical offset 0x00). Baseline value 0x82E707C7. No sum/xor/crc16/crc32 variant over any sub-range reproduces it, so it is stored as a plain u32, not a checksum spec.
fields.evidence: Word verified in baseline.sav rev8-logical bytes [00 00 00 00 block reversed to c7 07 e7 82 ...]; layout cross-checked against the parallel lead words of the mode blocks (FUN_08062524 numeric record-compare helper shows the game compares multi-word records field-by-field at struct offsets +0/+4/+8).
fields.name: profile_lead_word

fields.description: Player profile name, space-padded and NUL-terminated ('PLAYER' + spaces + 0x00). Baseline decodes to 'PLAYER'.
fields.evidence: NUL-terminated ASCII at rev8-logical save offset 0x08 (16 B). Game-side text path: FUN_08015898 is a byte-wise strlen loop to NUL, FUN_0801556c is the text codec/char-map routine, FUN_08015400 fetches indexed string records, and FUN_0804ba94 compares such records via the FUN_08063978 byte comparator.
fields.name: player_name

fields.description: 4-byte date stamp shared by all six save blocks (baseline bytes 14 03 07 20 in every block).
fields.evidence: Identical 4-byte stamp at rev8-logical offsets 0x28, 0x498, 0x848, 0xC40, 0x1040 and 0x1440 in baseline.sav; copied as part of each block tail by the game's record-store path (numeric/text record helpers FUN_08062524 / FUN_08063978).
fields.name: profile_date_stamp

fields.description: Trailing word of the profile block. Baseline value 74 (0x4A). Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical save offset 0x2C holds LE u32 74 in baseline.sav; parallel trailing words (112/110/143/131/125) close the other five blocks, so each block ends with a footer word (block-store pattern around the FUN_08062524 / FUN_0804ba94 record helpers).
fields.name: profile_footer_value

fields.description: First word of the 160-byte mode-A block (rev8-logical 0x400). Baseline value 0x02BC0010.
fields.evidence: Lead word verified at rev8-logical save offset 0x400 in baseline.sav; same struct position as the mode-B lead word at 0x800 (FUN_08062524 compares multi-word records starting at struct offset +0).
fields.name: mode_a_lead_word

fields.description: Second word of the mode-A block, identical value (0x00020000) at the same struct position in the mode-B block. Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical save offsets 0x408 and 0x808 both hold LE u32 0x00020000 in baseline.sav, i.e. a shared format/mode word at struct offset +8 (compared field-by-field by the FUN_08062524 numeric record comparator).
fields.name: mode_a_format_word

fields.description: Enable/active word of the mode-A block. Baseline value 1; same value at the matching mode-B position. Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical save offsets 0x40C and 0x80C both hold LE u32 1 in baseline.sav (struct offset +12, inside the word range compared by FUN_08062524).
fields.name: mode_a_active_flag

fields.description: Counter word unique to the mode-A block (mode-B has zero here). Baseline value 250 (0xFA). Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical save offset 0x414 holds LE u32 250 while the matching mode-B word at 0x814 is zero, so this is a per-mode counter field (numeric record word handled on the FUN_08062524 / FUN_08062ad0 numeric path).
fields.name: mode_a_counter

fields.description: Four LE u16 gauge/stat values of the mode-A block. Baseline decodes to [100, 100, 75, 80].
fields.evidence: Four consecutive LE u16s at rev8-logical save offset 0x468 in baseline.sav (00 06 00 06 00 0c 00 06 row above holds the matching sub-indexes); the parallel mode-B row at 0x830 holds [100, 100, 100, 100]. Numeric record words on the FUN_08062524 / FUN_08062624 compare path.
fields.name: mode_a_meter_values

fields.description: Tail record of the mode-A block: 8-byte ASCII tag 'CVCVCVCV', the shared 4-byte date stamp, and a LE u32 footer (112).
fields.evidence: Contiguous 16 B at rev8-logical save offset 0x490 in baseline.sav; every save block ends with tag + date stamp + footer word (same pattern at 0x840, 0xC38, 0x1038, 0x1438). ASCII tag bytes are covered by the FUN_08015898 / FUN_0801556c / FUN_08063978 text path.
fields.name: mode_a_tail_record

fields.description: First word of the 80-byte mode-B block (rev8-logical 0x800). Baseline value 0x02566B64.
fields.evidence: Lead word verified at rev8-logical save offset 0x800 in baseline.sav; parallel struct position to the mode-A lead word at 0x400 (FUN_08062524 numeric record compare from struct offset +0).
fields.name: mode_b_lead_word

fields.description: Shared format/mode word, same value (0x00020000) as mode-A offset 0x408. Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical save offset 0x808 holds LE u32 0x00020000, matching 0x408 exactly (struct offset +8 on the FUN_08062524 numeric record-compare path).
fields.name: mode_b_format_word

fields.description: Enable/active word of the mode-B block. Baseline value 1. Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Rev8-logical save offset 0x80C holds LE u32 1, matching 0x40C (struct offset +12 compared by FUN_08062524).
fields.name: mode_b_active_flag

fields.description: Four LE u16 gauge/stat values of the mode-B block. Baseline decodes to [100, 100, 100, 100].
fields.evidence: Four consecutive LE u16s (64 00 x4) at rev8-logical save offset 0x830 in baseline.sav, parallel to the mode-A row at 0x468 ([100, 100, 75, 80]). Numeric record words on the FUN_08062524 / FUN_08062624 compare path.
fields.name: mode_b_meter_values

fields.description: Tail record of the mode-B block: 8-byte ASCII tag 'DKDKDKDK', the shared 4-byte date stamp, and a LE u32 footer (110).
fields.evidence: Contiguous 16 B at rev8-logical save offset 0x840 in baseline.sav; same tag + date + footer tail pattern as the mode-A block at 0x490 and the three score tables. Tag bytes covered by the FUN_08015898 / FUN_08063978 text path.
fields.name: mode_b_tail_record

fields.description: Top score word of score table 1 (rev8-logical block 0xC00). Baseline value 29559. Mutable scalar suitable for live testing.
fields.evidence: Lead LE u32 of the first 72-byte score table at rev8-logical save offset 0xC00; the three tables open with 29559 / 28780 / 29298 while their entries stay below those ceilings. Ordered-record handling via the FUN_0804ba94 comparator (FUN_08015400 record fetch + FUN_08063978 byte compare) and the FUN_08062524 numeric record comparator.
fields.name: table1_top_score

fields.description: Six LE u32 score entries of score table 1, strictly descending. Baseline decodes to [6985, 5760, 4350, 2005, 760, 385].
fields.evidence: Six consecutive LE u32s at rev8-logical save offset 0xC08 in baseline.sav; tables 2 and 3 repeat the six-descending-u32 pattern at 0x1008 ([15820, 10155, 6185, 3350, 810, 410]) and 0x1408 ([6217, 5460, 4203, 2965, 1428, 719]). Ordered records served by FUN_0804ba94 / FUN_08063978 and compared numerically by FUN_08062524.

fields.description: Six 3-letter NUL-terminated entry initials of score table 1, one per score entry. Baseline decodes to HZH / AWR / SEC / ROD / BDB / JAC.
fields.evidence: 24 B of [3 chars + NUL] x6 at rev8-logical save offset 0xC20 in baseline.sav; tables 2 and 3 repeat the pattern at 0x1020 and 0x1420. NUL-terminated strings on the FUN_08015898 strlen + FUN_0801556c codec + FUN_08015400 indexed-fetch path, compared by FUN_0804ba94 / FUN_08063978.
fields.name: table1_entry_initials

fields.description: Tail record of score table 1: 8-byte ASCII tag 'WSWSWSWS', the shared 4-byte date stamp, and a LE u32 footer (143).
fields.evidence: Contiguous 16 B at rev8-logical save offset 0xC38 in baseline.sav; tables 2 and 3 repeat the tag + date + footer pattern at 0x1038 ('LPLPLPLP', footer 131) and 0x1438 ('RRRRRRRR', footer 125). Tag bytes are NUL-free ASCII covered by the FUN_08015898 / FUN_08063978 text path.
